title: International Pet Travel: How Pet Relocation Companies Help
htmlContent:
Relocating to a new country can be challenging, considering the paperwork, preparation, expenses, and formalities. When a pet is involved, the complications inevitably increase. In Singapore, the authorities are particularly concerned about allowing animals that are properly vaccinated and have safe levels. At times, you may encounter challenges in finding the right pet-friendly airline and completing the necessary documentation.   This is why the popularity of pet relocation companies is on the rise. These entities handle almost every aspect of pet relocation to Singapore and other nearby countries. Once you hire such a service provider, they will handle various aspects of pet relocation, including vaccination, certification, logistics, pet health during transit, quarantine clearance, and more. You will get a good experience by hiring trusted entities like Shiloh Animal Express.  
  • The hurdles pet owners experience during relocation
Pet owners may not always be knowledgeable about vaccinations and vet certification requirements. In Singapore, certain types of pets need specific vaccinations. Moreover, those vaccines have to be administered within a particular frame of time to be eligible. This will vary depending on the country of origin.   When you sign up for the services of a trusted and professional pet relocation company, it will do the research and offer you all the required guidance. They will make sure your pet gets vaccinated and certified by vets at the right time to be allowed entry into Singapore. This helps when you have a pet specific health needs. You can be assured of not facing any unexpected delay or legal hassles during transit.  
  • The importance of choosing the right crates and airlines
International pet travel often leads to long flights, cargo handling, and delays between connecting flights. This takes a toll on anyone, including your pets. Therefore, you need to pay attention to two things.  
  1. You need to find a suitable airline for relocating your pet.
  2. You need to find the right crate to ensure the animal or bird feels comfortable and secure during the journey.
  Pet relocation companies are experts in these nuances. They learn about your pet type and decide the most suitable airline. They will choose the airlines with pet-friendly policies and minimal layovers. These entities will also help their customers in getting the right crates for IATA compliance.  This leads to a smooth pet transit experience.  
  • Logistics service you can rely on
Top pet relocation service providers are not limited to getting the documentation for your pet. They help in customs clearance and getting necessary vet appointments, too. If quarantine is needed for the pet on arrival in Singapore, they can help speed things up.
  • Managing pet stress during relocation
Top-notch pet relocation companies handle a variety of pet animals and birds. They are experts in managing pet stress that can occur during relocation. They have tie-ups with vets and animal behavior experts to manage such situations.  

Final words

How do you spot a suitable company offering pet relocation services in Singapore? The entity must adhere to the IPATA guidelines. It should be clear about the pricing model, and it will not try to charge extra. Always look for an entity with many positive reviews.  Most importantly, it should be keen on animal welfare and logistics.
